title: alert.get
description: Retrieve alerts according to the given parameters.

alertids.description: Return only alerts with the given IDs.

actionids.description: Return only alerts generated by the given actions.

eventids.description: Return only alerts generated by the given events.

groupids.description: Return only alerts generated by objects from the given host groups.

hostids.description: Return only alerts generated by objects from the given hosts.

mediatypeids.description: Return only message alerts that used the given media types.

objectids.description: Return only alerts generated by the given objects.

userids.description: Return only message alerts that were sent to the given users.

eventobject.description: Return only alerts generated by events related to objects of the given type. See event 'object' (event/object) for a list of supported object types. Possible values for trigger events: 0 - trigger. Possible values for discovery events: 1 - discovered host; 2 - discovered service. Possible values for autoregistration events: 3 - auto-registered host. Possible values for internal events: 0 - trigger; 4 - item; 5 - LLD rule. Possible values for service events: 6 - service. Default: 0 - trigger.

eventsource.description: Return only alerts generated by events of the given type. See event 'source' (event/object) for a list of supported event types. Possible values: 0 - event created by a trigger (trigger events, default); 1 - event created by a discovery rule; 2 - event created by active agent autoregistration; 3 - internal event; 4 - event created on service status update.

time_from.description: Return only alerts that have been generated after the given time.

time_till.description: Return only alerts that have been generated before the given time.

selectHosts.description: Return a hosts (host/object) property with data of hosts that triggered the action operation.

selectMediatypes.description: Return a mediatypes (mediatype/object) property with an array of the media types that were used for the message alert.

selectUsers.description: Return a users (user/object) property with an array of the users that the message was addressed to. See user.get for restrictions based on user type.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values are: alertid, clock, eventid, mediatypeid, sendto and status.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
